column2: 条件文（ゼロ・第1・第2条件文）
column3: 常に真の事実、未来の現実的な可能性、現在の想像上の状況を表す。
column4: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.||If I were you, I would apply for that job.||If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
column5: ゼロ条件はif節も結果節も現在形。第1条件はif節に現在形、結果節にwill。第2条件は想像を表し、wouldを使う。
column6: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.||If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.

column2: 関係節（who / which / that / whose / where）
column3: 直前の名詞に関する追加情報を加える。
column4: The woman who lives next door is a doctor.||This is the phone which I bought yesterday.||That's the man whose car was stolen.
column5: 人にはwho、物にはwhichやthat、所有にはwhose、場所にはwhereを使うことが多い。
column6: The woman which lives next door is a doctor.||The woman who lives next door is a doctor.

column3: 別の動詞や前置詞の後ろで正しい動詞の形を選ぶ。
column4: I enjoy reading in the evening.||She decided to study abroad.||We look forward to meeting you.
column5: 動詞によって動名詞またはto不定詞を選ぶ。前置詞toの後ろでは動名詞になる場合がある。
column6: I enjoy to read in the evening.||I enjoy reading in the evening.

column2: 接続詞と前置詞（although / despiteなど）
column3: 同じような意味を持つ接続詞と前置詞を使い分ける。後ろが節か名詞句かに注目する。
column4: Although it was late, she kept working.||Despite the rain, the match continued.||The flight was canceled due to bad weather.
column5: althoughの後ろには節、despiteやdue toの後ろには名詞句を置く。
column6: Despite it was late, she kept working.||Although it was late, she kept working.

column3: 文の実際の主語に合わせて動詞を変える。
column4: The list of candidates is on the desk.||Every student has a laptop.||A number of employees are working from home.
column5: 主語と動詞の間にある名詞に惑わされず、主語の数に合わせる。everyは単数扱い、a number ofは複数扱い。
column6: The list of candidates are on the desk.||The list of candidates is on the desk.

column2: 語形（名詞・動詞・形容詞・副詞）
column3: 文中の位置から、空欄に必要な品詞を選ぶ。
column4: We made a final decision.||The new system works efficiently.||The room is available now.
column5: 冠詞の後ろには名詞、動詞を修飾する位置には副詞、be動詞の後ろには形容詞が来ることが多い。
column6: The new system works efficient.||The new system works efficiently.

column3: 過去の別の行動や時点より前に起きた行動を表す。
column4: When we arrived, the film had already started.||She had worked there for ten years before she retired.||By the time I called, he had left.
column5: hadと過去分詞を使い、過去の基準時より前の出来事を示す。
column6: When we arrived, the film already started.||When we arrived, the film had already started.

column3: 過去の別の行動や時点より前から、一定期間続いていた行動を表す。
column4: They had been waiting for an hour when the bus arrived.||He was tired because he had been running.||She had been working there for five years before she moved.
column5: had beenと動詞の-ing形を使い、過去の時点までの継続に焦点を置く。
column6: They had waiting for an hour.||They had been waiting for an hour.

column3: 未来の特定の時点や行動より前に完了する行動を表す。
column4: By Friday, I will have finished the report.||She will have left by the time you arrive.||By next year, they will have built the bridge.
column5: will haveと過去分詞を使う。byは完了の期限を示す。
column6: By Friday, I will finished the report.||By Friday, I will have finished the report.

column2: 第3条件文と混合条件文
column3: 過去と異なる結果を想像したり、過去の条件が現在の結果に影響したりすることを表す。
column4: If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the bus.||If she had studied medicine, she would be a doctor now.||Had I known, I would have helped.
column5: 第3条件文はif + had + 過去分詞、would have + 過去分詞。混合条件文では結果が現在に及ぶためwould beなどを使う。
column6: If I had left earlier, I wouldn't miss the bus.||If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the bus.
